pages.text: When a sealed room needs more oxygen than it gets, $(bold)flames go first$(), then people.

pages.title: Too Many Flames
pages.text: In vacuum, after $(bold)10 s$() of overload, flames go out one per second, hungriest first, until demand fits.$(br2)The room stays sealed and warm. Not a breach.

pages.title: What Goes Out
pages.text: $(li)Furnaces pause, keeping fuel and progress$(li)Torches go spent, lanterns dark$(li)Candles and campfires go out$(br2)Relight by hand. MiteAway keeps its charge.
Paused furnaces restart once spare capacity covers them for 2 s, even after a reload. New input resets progress.$(br2)Each lit candle counts.

pages.title: Not Enough Air
pages.text: If breathing alone still exceeds supply after 10 s, the room shows red $(bold)NO O2$().$(br2)Gas, pressure and heat stay. $(danger)Without an EVA tank or Emergency EVA reserve, you suffocate.$()
Add supply or thin the crowd. Air returns once supply holds for $(bold)2 s$(). Reloading creates none.$(br2)Early-phase air is unlimited and needs no Core.

pages.title: Warning Sounds
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Chime$(): gauge strained$(li)$(bold)Double beep$(): O2 shortage, ready EVA$(li)$(bold)Same beep, no gauge$(): $(danger)you are about to suffocate$(). Repeats every 2 s.
Red NO SEAL, NO AIR and NO O2 are silent, as is near-capacity yellow. Several panels give one warning per listener. No speech.
